description.value: Pizza Garden is a BC-based Neapolitan pizza chain operated by Neapolitan Pizza Ltd., with over 25 years in the industry and locations across British Columbia. The Victoria outpost sits on Government Street in the heart of downtown, serving wood-fired pizzas with charred crusts, sun-ripened tomatoes, and creamy mozzarella. Cyclists rolling through Victoria's core will find a central, accessible spot for a sit-down meal or a quick pickup order.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack (20 spaces) at 60m; stands (8 spaces) at 73m; rack (12 spaces) at 86m. Total: 40 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the Victoria location at 898 Government St matches the OSM address exactly (locations page). The front page and locations page confirm pickup ordering, establishing takeout as true. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the fetched content, so these remain null. The OSM phone number does not appear on the website, which uses a contact form only, so phone confirmation is null.
concerns: OSM phone number (+1-250-590-3389) is not displayed anywhere on the website; the site uses a contact form only, so the number cannot be confirmed or contradicted via website content.
The /events/catering subpage returned 'Not Found', though catering is advertised elsewhere on the site — minor content issue, not a business concern.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active multi-location pizza restaurant chain with the Victoria Government Street location confirmed on the business's own locations page. Useful stop for touring cyclists in downtown Victoria.
enrichment_extras.notes: Website Terms of Service identifies the legal operator as Neapolitan Pizza Ltd. A second Victoria location (University Heights) is listed as 'Coming Soon' on the locations page and is distinct from this OSM record.
